name: Caracolí (Colombia)
description: Yellow stripe along the top, the rest divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, green above and white below.
history: Municipal flag of Caracolí, a municipality in the department of Antioquia, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: lower part divided diagonally green over white
